statements.text: The sparrow flies using its wings, so it belongs in a flying group by type of movement and by body part used.
The duck swims using its webbed feet, so it belongs in a swimming group by type of movement and by body part used.
The earthworm crawls using its wings, so it belongs in a flying group.

stem:
Bilal watches a duck swim using its webbed feet, a sparrow fly using its wings, and an earthworm crawl using its body.

Which statements correctly group these animals by type of movement and by the body parts they use?

teacher.key_rationale: Grouping by movement type and body part: sparrow flies with wings; duck swims with webbed feet. Statement 3 wrongly gives the earthworm wings and a flying group.
